sloka: तं प्रश्रितस्ततो रामं श्रुतवाक्यो विभीषणः ।विमृश्य बुद्ध्या धर्मज्ञो धर्मार्थसहितं वचः ।रामस्यैवानुवृत्त्यर्थमुत्तरं प्रत्यभाषत ।। ६.११४.९३ ।।
transliteration: taṁ praśritastato rāmaṁ śrutavākyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।vimṛśya buddhyā dharmajño dharmārthasahitaṁ vacaḥ ।rāmasyaivānuvṛttyarthamuttaraṁ pratyabhāṣata ।। 6.114.93 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Rama spoke to Vibheeshana like this." Let the obsequies be carried out and all the women comforted."
